deviations.claim_in_article: “Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn” and the concluding claim that “oil prices stayed high” as tensions continued.
deviations.issue: The article generalizes from observations about Brent futures to oil prices across the market. The Ledger does not establish this broader market-wide claim.
deviations.explanation: The Ledger reports a temporary narrowing and recovery in Brent futures, not the behavior of oil prices across the whole market. The broader claim is also present in the Japanese source, so this is a scope expansion and unsupported claim originating there.
deviations.qualifier_text: “briefly lost some of their gains” (nearby description of Brent futures)
